description: Manual-capture authorization, partial capture, then reconcile against the refunds list.
note: Through 2024, partially capturing an authorization created a Refund for the uncaptured remainder; basil stopped doing that. Nothing in the schema changed. A reconciliation job that counts refunds silently gets a different answer, which is exactly the class of break this project exists to catch.

steps.note: The observable: one refund on version A, none on basil.
